label: No Flinch and Faster Succubus
summary: Succubus only flinches when hit during her clone attack, and her animations, attack timers, clones and wing spikes run faster.

edits.why: EntitySuccubus hit check: flinch (SetStep GET_HIT) on any odd step -> only when step == 11 (CLONE_ATTACK): andi 1/beqz -> xori 0xB/bnez
edits.onAltWhy: older full no-flinch form (Succubus-No-Flinch / Succubus-Revert-To-No-Flinch PPFs: beqz -> b at 0x1214C, step test vanilla) also counts as on

Faster: frame durations shortened (about 1/2 to 2/3) in D_80180760 attack-end anim
Faster: frame durations shortened (about 1/2 to 2/3) in D_80180780 pink-ball shooting anim

notes: Flinch: the Succubus-No-Flinch PPF first skipped the flinch branch (0x1214E 0x40->0x00), then Succubus-Flinch-Only-Clone-Attack / Scylla-...-Succubus-Clone-Flinch(-v2) restored it and changed the step test; Succubus-Revert-To-No-Flinch is NOT applied in a. So a = vanilla structure with 'step & 1' replaced by 'step == SUCCUBUS_CLONE_ATTACK (11)': she still takes damage and dies normally, but only reacts to hits during the clone attack. Faster: no PPF; added between images t and b together with the Reawakened port. 0x6D4-0x71A, 0x12898, 0x12998, 0x13194, 0x13260 match Reawakened's halved values; the other ~40 bytes are custom (about 2/3 durations) and do not match Reawakened. Off = o = v for every byte (1.3.1 Succubus = vanilla here). Not included: the ASS 1.3.1 pink-ball speed doubling at 0x143EC/0x14404 (v->o, kept in both states), and the 163 unattributed DRE tilemap bytes 0xB54C-0xBD46: those are ASS 1.3.1 tile edits in both Nightmare rooms that a reverts to vanilla (map/tile data, not Succubus behaviour). DRE's 235 unattributed o->a bytes = 163 tilemap + 38 animation + 34 code. The wing-spike tip 12x12 hitbox store is the only change that is not a speed change; it was added in the same batch, so it is grouped here.
